scope:
Native scientific review of all Echo atlas acquisition planes and anchors.

Unmodified production volume and shared-geometry GLSL, actual measured resident
source, exact production-MPR caps, and captured production draw/guide commands.
No browser, headless-browser substitute, build, publication, or image synthesis.
This 317.6 µm review establishes geometry/composition, not Ultra surface detail.

guide: Actual production projected Canvas2D vector commands, antialiased by Pillow; sector guides intentionally unoccluded, as in production. Font callouts are omitted; projected paths/colors are preserved, not Canvas2D pixel equivalence.
limitations: Not a browser screenshot or browser performance measurement.
Resident source spacing 317.6 µm; not the 79.4 µm Ultra surface or 19.85 µm native region.
Local fine replacement meshes/exclusions are omitted together; current reviewed lumen masks and baseline source-support cleanup are applied.
Illustrative body/instruments are fixed references, not clinically registered patient anatomy.
No clinical correspondence validation is inferred from geometric coplanarity.

integrationReview.integration: v63 orthogonal-section render scheduling merged without Echo geometry or shader changes
integrationReview.scope: Complete current-source export, actual production-worker cap sampling and native production-GLSL regeneration after the v63 merge. This compares geometry and rendered pixels; it does not benchmark browser scheduling or orthogonal-section interaction.
